afterRevision: The change containing this evidence; engine sources identified by SHA-256.
sourceDigestDefinition: Sorted paths relative to src; concatenate UTF-8 path, newline byte, and file bytes for each .ts file; SHA-256.

definitions.cohort: Two independent generated roster pairs (seeds 7, 19), each at strength 0.55. Fixed midfield alignment, Cover 3, no pressure. Three formations, five runs, two fronts, both flips, 30 reps/cell. Physical outcomes include fouls.
definitions.pairing: Identical generated rosters and named play seeds between revisions; changed behavior/contact can change the sequence of later physical RNG draws.
definitions.unassignedDLPerSnap: DE/DT slot agents without a RunBlocker primary/combination/pull/stalk target at initialization; assignment coverage, not successful contact.
definitions.ybc: Mean yardsBeforeContact over contactN only; combined using contactN weights, not zero-imputed for uncontacted plays.
definitions.climbsPerSnap: block_climb events / plays; baseline lacks these events so zero is missing telemetry, not no releases.
definitions.squeezePct: 100 * plays with a squeeze request event / plays; does not mean successfully passing through an opening. Baseline lacks posture.

before.cohort: One fixed generated roster pair; physical outcomes including fouls; same named seeds across runs. Not an NFL estimate.
